decisions.reason: Certified HVAC plate exchangers sit close to the core offer and are only mentioned on the website, but certification is a visible investment, so management keeps them.
The marine box cooler is publicly credited with a major market share in water cooling systems, and that strong visible commitment and positive result make dropping it very unlikely.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and builds on established marine know-how, a visible commitment management will persist with.
The compact oil cooler is only mentioned on the website and has little public commitment, so it is more exposed, but it fits the portfolio and has no evident failure.
Finned tubes for air coolers have a dedicated page and draw on in-house manufacturing investment, so writing them off would be costly to justify.
Enhanced exchanger tubes reflect R&D investment and are prominently presented, and they align with the announced innovation direction.
